title: Add a PreviewCard molecule to @grafting/ui for gallery-style tiles (cover image, tags, title/description)
objective:
Owner wants a richer card for grid/gallery tiles (starting with Architecture Studio's /lab trial cards), pasting two Ant Design Card examples (cover+actions+Meta, and an antd-style themed variant) as inspiration, and asked for help choosing Ant Design vs Mantine for it. Research found packages/ui/src/molecules/entity-summary.tsx already implements almost everything in those examples (title, description, StatusBadge status, tags, glowColor for 'live status', actions, selected/interactive) using only this package's own dependency-free Card/Text/StatusBadge/Button atoms, no Ant Design Card. packages/ui/DECISIONS.md's existing 'Card atom decision' already anticipated a future molecule needing a cover image, and separately found Ant Design's Card 'contributing nothing beyond a
' for EntitySummary's needs -- the same reasoning applies to a cover image (Ant Design's cover prop is just a styled div; a plain does the same job). Confirmed with the owner via AskUserQuestion: new molecule (PreviewCard) composing only the existing atoms plus a cover-image region, no Ant Design Card, no Mantine; EntitySummary stays untouched (different shape, already used in X6 node views/tables); a separate hover/glow behavior hook (packages/ui/src/hooks/) is explicitly deferred to a later task. Full design in the approved plan at C:\Users\PICHAU\.claude\plans\mellow-drifting-nova.md.

Exported from src/index.ts matching EntitySummary's export pattern.
